snippets.snippet_text: "Patreon gives you a direct line of access to your fan community, with no ads or gatekeepers in the way. Through real-time group chats, comments, DMs, and even directly over email, you can connect more deeply and directly with your community here than anywhere else."

"On Patreon, you can build a lasting business outside of the ad-based ecosystem, with revenue streams ranging from membership for offering ongoing benefits, to online shops for selling individual videos, podcast episodes, and more."
